title: Juniper and the Horizon
author: Wren Hartwell
blurb: Lior Lockridge, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
